note: No production or test change was needed; the existing implicit-value owners cover the contract.
covered: DW_OP_implicit_value reads an unsigned-LEB length and block for every length from 1 through the 4- or 8-byte pointer width
the block is zero-extended little-endian and its final byte is not treated as an opcode
zero, truncated, unterminated or wider-than-pointer blocks are rejected
DW_CFA_val_expression uses the scalar as the register value; DW_CFA_expression keeps address semantics unless DW_OP_stack_value is terminal
